title: Securities Industry Act (Commencement of Provisions) Order, 2024
text:
No. 32] Securities Industry 1
BELIZE:
STATUTORY INSTRUMENT
No. 32 of 2024
ORDER made by the Minister responsible for finance in
exercise of the powers conferred upon him by section
195 of the Securities Industry Act, 2021 (No. 46 of
2021), and all other powers thereunto him enabling.
(Gazetted 24th February, 2024)
1. This Order may be cited as the
Citation.
SECURITIES INDUSTRY ACT (COMMENCEMENT
OF PROVISIONS) ORDER, 2024.
2. In exercise of the powers conferred upon me by section Commencement
195 of the Securities Industry Act (Act No. 46 of 2021), and of remaining
provisions of Act
all other powers thereunto me enabling, I, JOHN BRICEÑO, No.46 of 2021.
Prime Minister and Minister responsible for finance, hereby
appoint the 16th day of January, 2024, as the day on which
the remaining provisions of the Securities Industry Act shall
come into force, namely–
(a) sections 23 to 32; and
(b) the provisions of Parts VI, VII and XV.
MADE by the Minister responsible for finance this 20th
day of February, 2024.

No. 32] Securities Industry 2
(HON. JOHN BRICEÑO)
Prime Minister and Minister of Finance,
Economic Development and Investment, Blue Economy and
Civil Aviation and Immigration
(Minister responsible for finance)
Printed in Belize by the Government Printer
#1 Power Lane, Belmopan
